name: list_chaos_catalog
title: Chaos catalog
description: What chaos Kates can run against this cluster: the fault types (disruptionType values), each marked with whether preview_disruption accepts it in an ad-hoc plan; the playbooks (name, category, step count, description); the chaos templates; and the registered chaos providers with their availability. The provider list does not say which provider injects faults. Templates are listed for reference only: no tool here can preview or run one. Descriptions are third-party text and fenced. Each section says when the backend failed to answer it. Takes no arguments and only reads.
